data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mufinella is rooted in its Hebrew origins. El, the prefix of the name, means ‘God’, highlighting the belief that each child is a gift from God and is under His divine protection. Yeladah, meaning little one, emphasizes the importance of nurturing and loving children, instilling values and faith, and guiding them to grow in the ways of the Lord. Overall, Mufinella carries a profound message of faith, protection, and love, reminding us that every child is a precious creation of God.
